**2Ship: Unbound** — 2 Ship 2 Harkinian with a native mod API: mods are `.o2r` packages with compiled code that register items, equipment, actors, bosses, dungeons, text and randomizer content. The mod SDK and its docs live in [`mod-sdk/`](https://github.com/skijer/2ship2harkinian/tree/unbound/mod-sdk).

**Setup**
1. Install like regular 2 Ship 2 Harkinian and run it once with your ROM.
2. Drop mods (`.o2r`) into `mods/`, or install them from the in-game NEI-Store (Network > NEI-Store).

The `unsafe-mods` downloads ask before loading each unsigned mod; they are for mod developers.
